correctness.rationale: The common vertex value fixes the mean exactly, yielding an orthogonal Hilbert direct sum of Dirichlet-bridge loops and anchored-Neumann-at-tip intervals; their explicit reproducing kernels give the precise pointwise squared norms and unnormalized length factors. Strict edgewise optimization and the positive-length ordering factorization establish the complete equality sets. The one-tail crossover is a unique affine zero, and calculus gives the attained sharp universal ratio 7-4√3. The included standalone exact-rational resistance checker independently verified 1595 sampled evaluation identities and 80 global-max/tie cases; finite diagnostics are not substituted for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The theorem answers the natural sharp unweighted arclength Sobolev embedding problem on every one-vertex mixed loop/spoke flower with arbitrary positive real lengths and complete equality classification. Its longest-petal/longest-spoke phase structure, exact pointwise deficits and the attained universal 7-4√3 one-tail bound are structural facts over infinite parameter families, providing more than a single routine example or numerical calculation.
